---
title: "Average Steps Around Heart Attack"
output:
  html_notebook:
    toc: true
params:
  daily_features_path: "../derived/daily_features_aligned.csv"
  window_before: 365
  window_after: 365
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'data.table' is required.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!requireNamespace("scales", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'scales' is required.", call. = FALSE)
}

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r load-data}
daily_features_path <- params$daily_features_path

if (!file.exists(daily_features_path)) {
  stop(
    sprintf(
      "Could not find daily features file: %s. Update params$daily_features_path.",
      daily_features_path
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

daily_features <- fread(daily_features_path)

required_columns <- c("subject_id", "relative_day", "steps_sum")
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(daily_features))
if (length(missing_columns)) {
  stop(
    sprintf(
      "daily_features_aligned.csv is missing required columns: %s",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

daily_features[
  ,
  `:=`(
    relative_day = as.integer(relative_day),
    steps_sum = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(steps_sum))
  )
]
```

```{r summarize-steps}
steps_window <- daily_features[
  relative_day >= -params$window_before &
    relative_day <= params$window_after &
    !is.na(steps_sum)
]

if (!nrow(steps_window)) {
  stop(
    sprintf(
      "No step data found between relative day -%s and +%s.",
      params$window_before,
      params$window_after
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

average_steps <- steps_window[
  ,
  .(
    average_steps = mean(steps_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_steps = median(steps_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    subject_count = uniqueN(subject_id),
    observation_count = .N
  ),
  by = relative_day
]

setorder(average_steps, relative_day)

average_steps[]
```

```{r plot-average-steps, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
ggplot(average_steps, aes(x = relative_day, y = average_steps)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#B91C1C") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "#1F6FEB") +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    span = 0.18,
    se = TRUE,
    color = "#111827",
    fill = "#CBD5E1",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-params$window_before, params$window_after, by = 90),
    minor_breaks = seq(-params$window_before, params$window_after, by = 30)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Steps Around Heart Attack",
    subtitle = "Day 0 is the heart attack date; line shows mean steps across subjects with data that day",
    x = "Days relative to heart attack",
    y = "Average daily steps"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#4B5563")
  )
```

```{r plot-sample-size, fig.width=11, fig.height=3.5}
ggplot(average_steps, aes(x = relative_day, y = subject_count)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#B91C1C") +
  geom_col(fill = "#6B7280", width = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-params$window_before, params$window_after, by = 90),
    minor_breaks = seq(-params$window_before, params$window_after, by = 30)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Subjects Contributing Step Data Per Relative Day",
    x = "Days relative to heart attack",
    y = "Subjects"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
